title: Plan a one-day academic workshop
task: Plan a one-day academic workshop for about 40 people in Manchester, UK, to take place about four months from now. I need: three candidate venues that can seat 40 with a projector (at least one on a university campus), what each costs for a day and what is included, a catering estimate per person for coffee breaks and lunch, a draft schedule for the day (keynote, two paper sessions, a poster or discussion slot), a total budget, and a timeline of tasks counting back from the event date (call for papers, registration, catering numbers).

requirements.text: Three venues in Manchester seating at least 40 with AV, at least one on a university campus, with day cost and inclusions.
Per-person catering estimate for breaks and lunch, and a total budget.
A draft schedule with keynote, two paper sessions and a poster or discussion slot.
A backwards timeline of preparation tasks with dates relative to the event.

checks.text: Each venue's capacity, price and facilities link to the venue's own page or rate card.
The venues are compared on cost, capacity, facilities, accessibility and what is included.
Prices that need a quote, or that are from rate cards that may be out of date, are marked as such.
The answer states when the venue and catering prices were looked up.

notes: Venue prices are often 'on request'; an answer that says so scores better than one that invents a number.
